claims.text: Technological progress matters only if it makes people's lives better.
claims.evidence: the only way that it really matters is if it makes people's lives like much better than they otherwise would have been.

claims.text: Concentration of power around AI is frightening.
claims.evidence: but concentration of power with AI is a terrifying thing. I don't think anyone should want to live in a world of AI overlords or company that is the rough equivalent of that.

claims.text: The earlier difficult period came from doing too many things without enough focus.
claims.evidence: I think we just we're doing too many things. We're not focused enough and they're actually all good things to do, but the trick is we're in this like unbelievable moment in history where you can only do the very few great things. So we spread ourselves too thin.
